title: Briefing DIA head General Patrick Hughes
summary: Steven Greer tells of Briefing DIA head General Patrick Hughes, about 1990s at Defense Intelligence Agency, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And I briefed a three-star general, Patrick Hughes.

plain: A man named Steven Greer, who has spent years trying to brief officials about UFOs, says that in the 1990s he briefed a three-star general, Patrick Hughes. According to the story, Hughes headed the Defense Intelligence Agency, the US military's own spy agency. If true, it would mean the claims reached very senior people in military intelligence.
